This plot is rented, so I do not want to put too much cash into it — if the owner takes it back next year, my manure and investment go with the land. Last season I used a small bit of DAP at planting because the cooperative had some, and I will try to do the same this year if the supply comes in time. I have my own seed saved from last harvest, but a neighbor got better cobs from an improved variety, so I will buy a small amount if I can afford it. Weeding is the big job here — me and my younger brother will handle most of it, but I may hire a few people for the first weeding since maize chokes fast if you are late.
